text:
Type: open-weave bamboo basket
Use: holding throws, plants or firewood on the floor; living room, bedroom, hallway
Style: bohemian, Japandi, coastal
Materials: woven bamboo strips
Colors: light natural bamboo, pale honey
Shape: wide round tub that tapers slightly toward the base, large airy grid of interlaced strips, rim bound with a flat band, open top, large but visually light
Feel: natural, airy, relaxed, warm
Goes with: green plants, linen, light wood, white walls; bohemian, Japandi or coastal rooms

product.name: GADDIS
product.description: Each basket is woven by hand and is therefore unique.
